message.content:
I’m sorry—I don’t have access to your current session information, so I can’t directly terminate it from here. If you’re using our web interface, simply click “Log Out” (or “Sign Out”) at the top‑right corner of the page. That will end your session securely. 

If you need help with another account action or troubleshooting why you might still see yourself as signed in after clicking Log Out, let me know!
message.reasoning:
The user wants us to "log them out". But we have no session context; they provide username/password but want logout. We cannot actually perform logout because there's no active session or API call defined for logging out. According to policy, we should not pretend to do anything. So respond politely explaining can't log out without session.

We can ask clarifying question about current session ID maybe. Or explain how they'd normally log out via UI. No tool usage needed.
